release_note: Kasandra's hand now works on the Field through her own door. Say in Talk, for example, 'trace Rail Demo bench readings and put Rev A beside Rev B', and she plans the fewest moves and makes them one at a time, showing each one on her card. At Ask first she offers the moves and waits for your Go ahead. Touching the window, Stop or Master Stop stops her before her next press, and 'Put my window back' returns the window to how she found it. She only moves around the desk in this release and never changes your data. Her planner is no longer tied to the Field, so acts for other apps can be added later.
